blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Patent search requires processing documents routinely exceeding tens of thousands of tokens. Most neural retrieval approaches operate on truncated inputs, limiting their effectiveness. Graph-based retrieval addresses this by representing each patent as a structured invention graph , but constructing these graphs relies on brittle rule-based parsers. We present the neural parser , which adapts biaffine attention from dependency parsing to predict invention graphs directly from patent text. Our local biaffine attention restricts pairwise scoring to a sliding window, reducing complexity from O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) to O ⁡ ( n ⋅ w ) O(n\cdot w) . Since local and global scoring share the same weights, the model trains on short sequences and deploys on documents exceeding 40,000 tokens without retraining. Distilled from 1 million rule-parsed documents, it surpasses its teacher at 3 × \times lower inference cost: neural graphs improve citation recall by 0.5% on short queries and 1.1% on full documents in a downstream Graph Transformer retrieval system.
blocks.zh: 专利检索需要处理文件,通常超过上万个令牌。 大多数神经检索方法都以截断输入方式运作,限制了其有效性. 基于图表的检索通过将每个专利作为结构化的发明图来解决这个问题,但构建这些图表依赖于基于Brittle规则的解析器. 我们提出神经分解器, 它使双鱼座的注意力 从依赖分解到预测发明图 直接从专利文本。 我们的局部双鱼座注意力限制双鱼座积分到滑动窗口, 将复杂度从 O → (n 2.) O(n^{2}) 降低到 O → (n w) O(n\cdot w) 。 由于地方和全球评分的分数相同,所以模范列车在短序列上运行,并在超过4万个令牌的文件中部署而无需再培训. 它从100万个规则解析文件中分离出来,以3xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Patent prior art search—identifying existing publications that may anticipate or render obvious a patent application’s claims—is essential in intellectual property law. Traditional Boolean keyword search [ 4 , 6 ] requires substantial domain expertise and multiple iterations, as similar concepts may use entirely different terminology across patent documents.
blocks.zh: 在知识产权法中,专利先行的艺术搜索——确认可能预见或明显表明专利申请要求的现有出版物——至关重要。 传统的布尔关键词搜索[4,6]需要大量领域专门知识和多种迭代,因为类似的概念在专利文件中可能使用完全不同的术语。

blocks.en: Neural dense retrieval models overcome terminology variation by learning semantic representations [ 11 , 1 , 9 ] , but face a fundamental length constraint: patent documents are extremely long. In our training corpus of 1 million patent documents, descriptions average 55,000 characters (median: 40,000), with the 90th percentile at 104,000 characters. Current models process only truncated inputs—typically titles and abstracts [ 11 , 1 , 9 ] —sacrificing coverage of claim-relevant content in the full text.
blocks.zh: 神经密集检索模型通过学习语义表达[11, 1, 9]来克服术语差异,但面临一个基本的长度限制:专利文件极其长. 在我们的100万个专利文件的培训材料中,描述的人物平均为55,000个(中间数:40,000个),其中第90%为104,000个。 目前的模型只处理短短的投入——通常为标题和摘要[11、1、9]——在全文中记录与索赔有关的内容。

blocks.en: Invention graphs address this by extracting core technical features and organizing them hierarchically [ 3 ] , compressing patents into structured representations suitable for neural processing. Graph Transformers [ 5 ] process these structures via sparse attention over graph edges, enabling effective handling of documents exceeding 40,000 tokens—far beyond what standard dense retrieval supports [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 发明图通过取出核心技术特征并将其分级排列[3],将专利压缩为适合于神经处理的结构化表述来解决这个问题. Graph Transformers[5]通过在图边上很少注意处理这些结构,从而能够有效地处理超过40,000个令牌的文件——远远超过标准的密集检索支持[22]。

blocks.en: Figure 1: End-to-end patent prior art search pipeline. Patent documents and user queries are parsed into invention graphs, encoded by a Graph Transformer [ 5 ] into dense vectors, and matched via nearest neighbor search. This work replaces the rule-based parser with a neural alternative (highlighted).
blocks.zh: 图1:端到端专利前期艺术搜索管道. 专利文件和用户查询被解析成发明图,由一图变形器[5]编码为密集向量,并通过最近的相邻搜索进行匹配. 这项工作用神经替代(突出)取代了基于规则的解析器.

blocks.en: Existing graph-based patent search systems [ 3 , 5 ] rely entirely on rule-based parsers with extensive hand-crafted patterns. While achieving high precision on matched patterns, these parsers suffer from brittleness: they fail silently on novel linguistic constructions and require continuous manual curation as patent language evolves. A natural alternative is a learned graph induction model, but standard neural structured prediction methods—such as biaffine dependency parsers [ 7 ] —require scoring all O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) token pairs, making them intractable for documents with tens of thousands of tokens. Obtaining labeled training data at corpus scale is a further obstacle: manually annotating graph structures across millions of documents is impractical.
blocks.zh: 现有的基于图表的专利搜索系统[3,5]完全依赖于具有广泛手工制作模式的基于规则的剖析器. 虽然在匹配的图案上实现了高精度,但这些剖析器却受到不洁之苦:它们默默地在新颖的语言构造上失败了,随着专利语言的演化,需要连续的人工校正. 一个自然的替代办法是学习到的图表诱导模型,但是标准神经结构的预测方法——如双鱼依赖分解器[7]——需要给所有O ⁡ (n 2) O (n ^{2}) 符对打分,使其对有上万个符的文档难以操作. 获得标有标记的培训数据是另一个障碍:手动说明数百万份文件的图表结构是不切实际的。

blocks.en: We address both challenges with the following contributions: • Scalable structured prediction : We extend sliding-window biaffine attention [ 17 ] from flat span extraction to structured prediction (tree/DAG induction) over full-length patent documents. Crucially, local and global scoring share the same weight matrix, so the model trains on short sequences with global attention and deploys on long documents with local attention—no retraining required. • Student surpasses teacher : Via knowledge distillation on 1 million rule-parsed documents, our neural parser generalizes beyond hand-crafted patterns, yielding better graph quality and improved downstream prior art search, while offering 3 × \times lower inference cost and flexibility for diverse data sources (human annotation, LLM-generated labels).
blocks.zh: • 可扩展的结构预测: 我们把从平坦取出到结构化预测(树木/DAG诱导)的双花膜从全长的专利文件上扩展至滑入窗口的注意[17]。 关键是,地方和全球的评分都具有相同的分量矩阵,因此模式列车在有全球关注的短序列上,在有地方关注的长文件中部署——不需要再培训. • 学生超过教师: 在100万份规则分解文件中通过知识分解,我们的神经分解器概括了超出手工制作的图案,产生了更好的图表质量并改进了之前的下游艺术搜索,同时为各种数据来源(人类注释,LLM生成的标签)提供了3×xxx时间更低的推论成本和灵活性.

blocks.en: Scalable structured prediction : We extend sliding-window biaffine attention [ 17 ] from flat span extraction to structured prediction (tree/DAG induction) over full-length patent documents. Crucially, local and global scoring share the same weight matrix, so the model trains on short sequences with global attention and deploys on long documents with local attention—no retraining required.
blocks.zh: 可缩放结构预测: 我们把从平坦取出到结构化预测(树木/DAG诱导)的双花膜从全长的专利文件上扩展至滑入窗口的注意[17]。 关键是,地方和全球的评分都具有相同的分量矩阵,因此模式列车在有全球关注的短序列上,在有地方关注的长文件中部署——不需要再培训.

blocks.en: Student surpasses teacher : Via knowledge distillation on 1 million rule-parsed documents, our neural parser generalizes beyond hand-crafted patterns, yielding better graph quality and improved downstream prior art search, while offering 3 × \times lower inference cost and flexibility for diverse data sources (human annotation, LLM-generated labels).
blocks.zh: 学生超过教师: 在100万份规则分解文件中通过知识分解,我们的神经分解器概括了超出手工制作的图案,产生了更好的图表质量并改进了之前的下游艺术搜索,同时为各种数据来源(人类注释,LLM生成的标签)提供了3×xxx时间更低的推论成本和灵活性.

blocks.en: To support reproducibility, we release: (1) the evaluation set of 5,000 annotated patent documents used for intrinsic evaluation, (2) a 5,000-document sample from the training set, and (3) the evaluation framework for computing the graph quality metrics reported in this paper. 1 1 1 Available at https://github.com/iprally/invention_graph_eval .
blocks.zh: 为了支持可复制性,我们发布了:(1) 用于内在评价的5 000份附有说明的专利文件的一套评价文件;(2) 培训集的5 000份文件样本;以及(3) 本文件所汇报的计算图表质量衡量标准的评价框架。 1 1 1 见https://github.com/iprally/invention_graph_eval。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Patent Retrieval and Graph Representations
blocks.zh: 2.1 专利检索和图示

blocks.en: Dense retrieval has become the leading neural approach to patent search. Transformer models fine-tuned for patents [ 1 , 9 ] , including PaECTER [ 11 ] with citation-informed embeddings, outperform general-purpose models [ 15 ] , but even recent benchmarks support at most 4,096 tokens [ 14 ] —far short of typical patent descriptions. LongEmbed [ 22 ] confirms that embedding models degrade substantially beyond 2,048 tokens.
blocks.zh: Dense reference已经成为专利检索的主要神经方法. 变形器模型在专利[1,9]方面进行了微调,包括PaECTER [11] 有引文知情嵌入,优于通用模型[15],但即使是最近的基准支持最多4,096个令牌[14]——远不及典型的专利描述. LongEmbed [22] 证实嵌入式模型大幅降解出2,048个令牌.

blocks.en: Graph-based retrieval addresses this. Invention graphs encoded with Tree-LSTMs [ 3 , 16 ] significantly improve retrieval over bag-of-words baselines, and a Graph Transformer approach [ 5 , 8 , 18 ] achieves further gains via sparse attention over graph edges. Both systems rely on rule-based parsers—the bottleneck this work addresses. Open relation extraction from patent claims [ 10 ] produces flat triples rather than the hierarchical representations required for structured retrieval.
blocks.zh: 基于图表的检索处理此问题 。 由树-LSTM编码的发明图[3,16]大大地改进了取自袋字基线的检索,并用图变形器方法[5,8,18]通过图边上的稀疏注意力来取得进一步的收益. 这两个系统都依赖基于规则的解析器——这是这项工作地址的瓶颈。 从专利请求中提取的开放式关系[10]产生平平的三重形式,而不是结构化检索所需的分级表述.

blocks.en: 2.2 Neural Structured Prediction for Long Documents
blocks.zh: 2.2 长文件的神经结构预测

blocks.en: Our formulation adapts biaffine attention from dependency parsing [ 7 ] , where separate MLPs project words into head and dependent roles and a biaffine function scores pairwise arcs. While biaffine parsing remains the dominant paradigm for syntactic and semantic dependency parsing, existing methods operate at sentence level. DocBAN [ 17 ] recently applied sliding-window biaffine attention to document-level NER, reducing quadratic complexity to linear for span extraction. Our work addresses the harder problem of structured prediction—inducing tree and DAG structures via per-word parent selection rather than identifying flat spans—at much longer document scales (40,000+ vs. thousands of tokens).
blocks.zh: 我们的配方从依赖分解 [7] 调整了双氟素的注意力,其中将 MLPs 项目单词分为头和相依赖的角色和一个双氟素函数得分对等弧. 虽然biaffine解析仍然是合成和语义依赖解析的主要范例,但现有方法在句子层面运作。 DocBAN [17] 最近对文档级NER应用了滑窗双发管注意,将四相复杂度降低为线性以进行跨取取. 我们的工作解决了结构化预测的更难问题——通过逐字的父字选择来引导树和DAG结构,而不是确定平整的跨度——在更长的文件尺度(40,000+对上千个符号)。

blocks.en: Processing such long sequences requires efficient attention. Longformer [ 2 ] and BigBird [ 19 ] introduced sparse attention combining local windows with global tokens in the transformer encoder. We use Longformer as our encoder but introduce sparsity in the biaffine scoring layer—the computational bottleneck for structured prediction. A key distinction from DocBAN, which adds a U-Net module for cross-window context, is that our local biaffine mechanism uses exactly the same weight matrix as global scoring. This weight-sharing property enables training with global attention on short sequences and deploying with local attention on long documents without retraining (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 处理这种长序列需要高效的注意. Longformer [2]和BigBird [19]在变速器编码器中引入了将本地窗口与全局符号相结合的稀有关注. 我们使用Longformer作为编码器,但在双鱼座积分层中引入了斯帕森特-结构化预测的计算瓶颈. 与DocBAN的一个关键区别是,它为跨窗口上下文添加了一个U-Net模块,就是我们的本地双鱼机制使用与全球分数完全相同的权重矩阵. 这种权重分担财产使全球能够注意短序列的培训,并在当地注意长期文件,而不进行再培训(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: We train via knowledge distillation [ 12 ] from a rule-based teacher. Combined with loss weighting (Section 3.3 ), this provides sufficient signal for the model to generalize beyond hand-crafted patterns without manual annotation at corpus scale.
blocks.zh: 我们通过知识蒸馏来从一个基于规则的老师那里训练。 这与损失加权相结合(第3.3节),为模型提供了足够的信号,使之在不人工说明体积的情况下,超越手工制作的模式而通用。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Invention Graphs
blocks.zh: 3.1 发明图

blocks.en: An invention graph represents a patent’s technical content as two complementary structures (Figure 2 ). The feature hierarchy is a tree of technical components organized by part-of and example-of relationships, signaled by terms such as comprising and including . Functional relations capture cross-cutting dependencies between features via verbal constructions (e.g., “ Engine configured to rotate Wheels ”). Features have a single hierarchical parent but may participate in multiple relations, yielding a directed acyclic graph (DAG). In the neural parser, both structures are modeled as per-word parent predictions forming tree-like hierarchies.
blocks.zh: 发明图作为两个互补结构(图2)代表了专利的技术内容. 特征等级是一棵由关系部分和实例排列的技术组成部分之树,由诸如组成和包括......之类的术语所象征。 功能关系通过口头构造(例如“为旋转轮而配置的发动机”)捕捉特性之间的交叉依赖性。 地物具有单层父体,但可能参与多层关系,产生有定向的循环图(DAG). 在神经分解器中,两种结构都是以按词母预测形成树状分层为模型.

blocks.en: Figure 2: A patent claim (US20250197034A1) and the corresponding invention graph. Blue bullets denote feature nodes; purple bullets denote functional relations. Indentation reflects hierarchical (part-of) edges. Features referenced inside relations are shown in uppercase.
blocks.zh: 图2:一项专利要求(US20250197034A1)和相应的发明图. 蓝色子弹表示特征节点;紫色子弹表示功能关系. 缩入反映了等级(部分)边缘. 内部关系引用的特征以大写显示.

blocks.en: The model operates at the word level, predicting for each word: (1) a parent in the feature hierarchy (or a pseudo-node for non-graph words), (2) an edge label distinguishing within-phrase (syntactic) from between-feature (semantic) edges, and (3) a parent in the relation hierarchy. Syntactic edges are used in postprocessing to assemble multi-word feature spans from individual word predictions.
blocks.zh: 该模型在单词级别上运行,对每个单词进行预测:(1)特征分级中的父词(或非图词的伪节点),(2)边缘标签区分内词(同义词)与地词(语义词)之间边缘,(3)关系分级中的父词. 在后处理中使用Syntactic 边缘来从单个单词预测中组装多字特征跨度.

blocks.en: A deployment constraint shapes the architecture: the neural parser must produce graphs structurally identical to rule-based output—same node types, edge labels, and relation format—for backward compatibility and controlled A/B testing in the search pipeline of [ 5 ] . This rules out alternative approaches (e.g., NER with heuristic tree assembly, sequence-to-sequence generation) that would produce different graph formats. The per-word parent prediction formulation directly mirrors the rule-based system’s output, making biaffine structured prediction [ 7 ] the natural choice. LLM-based extraction is prohibitively expensive at corpus scale---parsing 150 million documents costs over $80,000 in input tokens alone 2 2 2 Estimated using Gemini 2 Flash Lite batch API ($0.0375 per million input tokens) while output tokens at least double this vs. under $10,000 on spot GPU instances (Section 5.3 )—and introduces rate-limit and schema-consistency risks. LLM-generated labels nonetheless remain promising for augmenting training data beyond the rule-based teacher ceiling.
blocks.zh: 部署制约塑造了架构:神经分解器必须在结构上与基于规则的输出完全相同——相同的节点类型,边缘标签,以及关系格式——用于在 [5] 的搜索管道中的后向相容性和受控A/B测试. 这排除了产生不同图表格式的替代方法(如有恒树组装的NER,序列到序列生成等). 单词母预测配体直接与基于规则的系统输出相映射,使biaffine结构预测[7]成为自然选择. 基于LLM的取出量在体积上是极其昂贵的 -- -- 分解1.5亿份文件的费用超过80 000个输入符,仅是2 2 2 估计使用双子座2 Flash Lite 批号API(每百万个输入符为0.0375美元),而输出符则至少是当场GPU情况下10 000美元以下的两倍(第5.3节),并引入了限速和符合计划的风险。 然而,LLM产生的标签仍然有望在教师上限的基础上增加培训数据。

blocks.en: 3.2 Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.2 示范建筑

blocks.en: Our architecture extends the biaffine dependency parser of Dozat and Manning [ 7 ] for invention graph induction. As shown in Figure 3 , the model has three components: a contextual encoder and two parallel prediction heads.
blocks.zh: 我们的建筑扩展了多扎特和曼宁的双叶琴依赖分解 [7] 用于发明图感应. 如图3所示,该模型有三个组成部分:上下文编码器和两个平行预测头.

blocks.en: We define words as whitespace-delimited units of the input text. Each word is encoded into a fixed number of subword tokens ( k = 3 k{=}3 ) by the pretrained tokenizer, and the full subword sequence is processed by XLM-RoBERTa-Longformer [ 2 ] . A learned scalar mix over the last 4 hidden layers is followed by mean pooling over each word’s subword tokens, producing one representation per word. All subsequent scoring operates at this word level. To extend the encoder beyond its native 16,384-subword limit, we tile the learned position embedding matrix to support sequences up to 65,536 subwords. This requires no retraining: sequences within the original range use pretrained positions unchanged; longer sequences receive repeated embeddings that are suboptimal but sufficient under local attention.
blocks.zh: 我们定义单词为输入文本的白空间限制单位 。 每个单词由被预先训练的活化器编码成固定数量的子词符号(k = 3 k{=}3),完整的子词序列由XLM-RoBERTa-Longformer处理 [2]. 在过去4个隐藏层中学习到的分层组合之后,每个字的子字符号都会被平均地集合起来,每个字产生一个表示。 所有之后的评分都在这个单词级别上运行. 为了将编码器扩展至其原生的16,384个子字限制之外,我们把所学入位嵌入矩阵来支撑到65,536个子字的序列. 这不需要再培训:原范围内的序列使用事先训练过的姿势不变;更长的序列接受重复嵌入,虽然不理想,但在当地关注下足够.

blocks.en: Each prediction head projects encoder outputs through separate MLPs for dependent and head roles, then scores pairs using biaffine attention [ 7 ] : s ⁡ ( i , j ) = 𝐡 i dep ⊤ ​ 𝐖𝐡 j head + 𝐛 ⊤ ​ 𝐡 i dep s(i,j)={\mathbf{h}_{i}^{\text{dep}}}^{\top}\mathbf{W}\mathbf{h}_{j}^{\text{head}}+\mathbf{b}^{\top}\mathbf{h}_{i}^{\text{dep}} (1) The Feature Head uses two parallel biaffine scorers: one for parent prediction ( 𝐒 arc ∈ ℝ n × n \mathbf{S}^{\text{arc}}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n} ) and one for edge label classification ( 𝐒 label ∈ ℝ n × n × K \mathbf{S}^{\text{label}}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n\times K} ), distinguishing syntactic edges (within-phrase) from semantic edges (between features). The Relation Head uses a single biaffine scorer ( 𝐒 rel ∈ ℝ n × n \mathbf{S}^{\text{rel}}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n} ) for functional relationships. Unlike dependency parsing, where every word belongs to a single-rooted tree, invention graphs admit multiple roots and exclude most document words. Two pseudo-nodes— None (index 0) and Root (index 1)—model these decisions, allowing each word to be classified as a non-feature, a root feature, or attached to a parent within the graph.
blocks.zh: 每个预测头项目编码器输出通过独立的MLP来表示依赖和头部角色,然后使用双发管注意来分数对 [7] : s ⁡ (i, j) = h i dep ⊤ Wh j 头 + b ⊤ h  de dep s (i, j) ={\ mathbf{ h}_{i}^{\text{ dep}}}^{\top}\ mathbf{ W}\ mathbftext{ h}_{j}^{\text{ b}^{\ttopttopmathbff{h}_{i}^{\text{dep}}} (1)Feature Head使用两个并列双发分数器:一个用于母体预测(Sarc ∈ R n × n\ mathbf{S}^{\text{arc}}\in\ mathbb{R}^{n\times n}),一个用于边缘标签分类(S label}}\in\mathb{ S}^{\text{label}}\in\ mathbb{R}^{n\times n\times K}),区分语义边缘(内词)和语义边缘(特征之间). 关系头用单双鱼座计分器(S rel ∈ R n × mathbf{S}^{\text{rel}}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n})来进行功能关系. 与依赖解析不同的是,每个单词都属于一株被根植于一株树上,发明的图表承认了多根并排除了大多数文档词. 两个假节点——无(index 0)和Root(index 1)——模拟这些决定,使每个单词都能够被归类为非地貌,是根特征,或者被附在图表中的父词上.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Model architecture. The Feature Head predicts parent structure and edge labels (syntactic vs. semantic); the Relation Head predicts functional relationships.
blocks.zh: 图3:示范建筑。 地物头能预测母体结构和边缘标签(同义词与语义词);关系头能预测功能关系.

blocks.en: 3.3 Local Biaffine Attention
blocks.zh: 3.3 当地生物注意

blocks.en: Standard biaffine attention computes all O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) pairwise scores, which is prohibitive for documents exceeding 40,000 words. Following the sliding-window principle of [ 17 ] , our local biaffine attention reduces complexity to O ⁡ ( n ⋅ w ) O(n\cdot w) by restricting each word to score only positions within a window of size w w , plus two pseudo-nodes. For word i i , the candidate set is: 𝒩 ⁡ ( i ) = { None , Root } ∪ { j : | i − j | ≤ w / 2 } \mathcal{N}(i)=\{\textsc{None},\textsc{Root}\}\cup\{j:|i-j|\leq w/2\} (2) This produces a score tensor of shape [ n , w + 2 ] [n,w{+}2] instead of [ n , n ] [n,n] , as illustrated in Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: 标准双鱼座注意力计算出所有O QQ(n 2) O(n^{2})双鱼座分,这对超过4万个字的文件来说是令人望而却步的. 按照 [17] 的滑入-窗口原则,我们本地的双节点注意力通过限制每个单词在大小 w w 的窗口内只分到位置,加上两个假节点,从而将复杂性降低到 O → (n ⋅ w) O (n\cdot w) . 对于i字,候选人集为:N → (一) = {无,根起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起 (单位:千美元) (2) 如图4所示,这会产生形状 [n, w + 2] [n,w{+}2] 的分数角,而不是 [n, n, [n,n] 。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Global vs. local biaffine score matrices. Global attention computes all n 2 n^{2} scores; local attention computes only n ⁡ ( w + 2 ) n(w{+}2) scores within a sliding window plus two pseudo-node columns. Both modes share the same weight matrix 𝐖 \mathbf{W} , enabling training with global attention on short sequences and inference with local attention on long sequences.
blocks.zh: 图4:全球与本地双鱼座分数矩阵. 全局关注计算出所有n 2 n^{2}的分数;局部关注只计算出n  (w + 2) n (w{+}2) 在滑动窗口内分数加上两个伪节点列. 两种模式都共享了相同的权重矩阵 W\ mathbf{W},使得在短序列上进行全球关注的培训,并在长序列上进行本地关注的推论.

blocks.en: A key property of our local attention is that it uses exactly the same weight matrix 𝐖 \mathbf{W} as global biaffine attention—only the set of positions scored differs. This enables training with global attention on short sequences (600 words) and deploying with local attention on long documents (40,000+ words), or switching window sizes at inference time without retraining.
blocks.zh: 我们当地关注的一个关键属性是 它使用完全相同的重量矩阵 W\ mathbf{ W}作为全球双鱼座的注意——只有得分的一组位置不同. 这使得可以进行全球关注短序列(600个字)的培训,并在当地关注长文档(40,000个字),或者在推论时转换窗口大小而不进行再培训。

blocks.en: We compute local scores efficiently using a chunking strategy adapted from Longformer [ 2 ] : the sequence is divided into overlapping chunks of size 2 ​ w 2w with stride w w , biaffine scores are computed within each chunk, and diagonal bands are extracted via a skew operation to produce the sliding window format. Pseudo-node scores are computed globally (as each word may be None or Root regardless of position) and concatenated with the window scores. Words near sequence boundaries have their windows masked to prevent attending to invalid positions.
blocks.zh: 我们使用由Longformer[2]改编的分块策略,高效计算本地分数: 序列被分成大小为2 w 2w 并带有 stride w w 的相重叠块; 双叶林分数在每个块内计算; 双叶林分数通过 skew 操作提取来生成滑动窗口格式。 Pseudo-node分数是全球计算(因为每个单词可能都是None或Root,无论位置如何),并与窗口分数相配合. 近于序列边界的单词被遮住其窗口来防止前往无效位置.

blocks.en: Patent text exhibits strong locality in hierarchical relationships: a component is typically described near its parent in the claim structure. Analysis of rule-parsed training graphs confirms that the vast majority of parent-child edges fall within a small window (Section 5.2 ); the relation head similarly benefits, as functional relationships are usually expressed in contiguous text spans.
blocks.zh: 专利文本显示出等级关系中的显著位置:在索赔结构中,通常在母体附近描述一个组成部分。 对规则分解的训练图的分析证实,绝大多数亲子边缘属于一个小窗口(第5.2节);关系头也具有类似的好处,因为功能关系通常以相接的文本跨度来表示.

blocks.en: Training Objective
blocks.zh: 培训目标

blocks.en: Both the feature parent and relation heads are trained with weighted cross-entropy: ℒ head = − ∑ i ∈ ℳ α y i log exp ⁡ ( S i , y i ) ∑ j exp ⁡ ( S i , j ) \mathcal{L}_{\text{head}}=-\sum_{i\in\mathcal{M}}\alpha_{y_{i}}\log\frac{\exp(S_{i,y_{i}})}{\sum_{j}\exp(S_{i,j})} (3) where ℳ \mathcal{M} is the set of non-padded word positions and α k \alpha_{k} are per-class weights. Since most words do not participate in the graph, the None class dominates; we set α None = 0.05 \alpha_{\textsc{None}}=0.05 for the feature head and 0.1 0.1 for the relation head, with all other positions receiving weight 1.0 1.0 (see ablation in Section 5.2 ). The edge label head uses standard cross-entropy at the gold parent position [ 7 ] . The total loss is ℒ = ℒ parent + ℒ label + ℒ rel \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\text{parent}}+\mathcal{L}_{\text{label}}+\mathcal{L}_{\text{rel}} .
blocks.zh: 特征父和亲子两个头都受过加权交叉性训练: L头=- i ∈ M α i 日志 ⁡ (S i, y i) ∑ (S i, j i i) ∑ (S i, j i i i) ∑ (S i, j i) ∑ (S i, j ) } (S i, j ) } (S i, j ) } (S i) } (S i, j ) } (S i, j )) (3) M\mathcal{M}是非加词位置的一组,而α k\ alpha_{k}是每等重. 由于大多数单词不参与图中,"无"类占据了主导地位;我们设定了 α None = 0.05\ alpha_{\textsc{None}}=0.05 特性头和0.1 0.1 关系头,所有其他位置都得到重量1.0 1.0 (见第5.2节中的ablation). 边缘标签头在金母位置使用标准横切[7]. 总损失为: L = L 父母 + L 标签 + L 标记 + L rel\ mathcal{ L}=\-Mathcal{ L}_{\-text{父母 }}+\-Mathcal{L}_{\-text{label}}+\-mathcal{L}_{\-text{rel}}} 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 3.4 Training Data and Setup
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训数据和设置

blocks.en: Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 数据集建设

blocks.en: The training dataset is constructed using invention graphs generated by the rule-based system of [ 3 ] , which has been deployed in production for over 5 years and has processed more than 150 million patent documents. This system uses spaCy [ 13 ] for linguistic analysis combined with regular expression patterns for relation extraction.
blocks.zh: 培训数据集采用以规则为基础的系统[3]生成的发明图来构建,该系统已投入生产5年多,并处理了1.5亿多份专利文件. 这个系统用温泉水 Cy [13] 用于语言分析,结合正则表达模式进行关系提取.

blocks.en: We sample 1 million patent documents from the full patent corpus, stratified by jurisdiction: 60% US patents, 20% Chinese patents (translated to English), and 20% from other jurisdictions.
blocks.zh: 我们抽取了100万份来自全专利权的专利文件,按法域分级:60%的美国专利,20%的中国专利(译为英文),20%来自其他法域。

blocks.en: To prevent data leakage and near-duplicate contamination, we deduplicate by patent family ID: the same invention may appear under different document identifiers across jurisdictions (e.g., US, EP, CN) with near-identical text, so only one document per family is retained across all splits. All families appearing in either the intrinsic evaluation set (5,000 documents) or the downstream search evaluation set (90,082 queries) are excluded from training entirely.
blocks.zh: 为防止数据泄露和近似重复的被污染,我们通过专利家族识别码来复制:同样的发明可能在不同的文件识别码下出现,跨司法管辖区(如美国,EP,CN)的文本几乎相同,因此在所有分块中每个家族只保留了一份文件. 内在评价套件(5 000份文件)或下游搜索评价套件(90 082个查询)中出现的所有家庭都完全被排除在培训之外。

blocks.en: To enable efficient training with global attention, we apply a maximum sequence length of 600 words. Documents are truncated to this limit, but we require a minimum coverage threshold of 70%—documents where truncation would retain less than 70% of the original graph structure are excluded.
blocks.zh: 为了能够得到全球关注的高效训练,我们应用了600个字的最大序列长度. 文件被缩短到这个限度,但我们要求最小覆盖阈值为70分之一的文件,其中短线保留不到原始图表结构的70%。

blocks.en: We hold out 5,000 documents randomly sampled from the patent corpus for evaluation. Unlike training, test documents are processed at full length using local attention, enabling assessment of generalization to long documents not seen during training.
blocks.zh: 我们持有5000份文件 随机抽样 从专利权评估。 与培训不同的是,测试文件是利用当地注意力进行全长处理的,从而能够评估培训期间没有看到的长期文件的通用情况。

blocks.en: Training Configuration
blocks.zh: 培训配置

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes our training hyperparameters.
blocks.zh: 表1概述了我们的培训超参数。

blocks.en: Table 1: Training hyperparameters. Architecture and regularization details in Sections 3.2 – 3.3 .
blocks.zh: 表1:培训超参数。 第3.2至3.3节的架构和规范化细节。

blocks.en: Training runs for 100 epochs distributed across 8 NVIDIA L4 GPUs using Ray data-parallel, taking approximately 60 hours. We select the best checkpoint by whole graph IoU (Section 4.1 ) on the validation set.
blocks.zh: 培训为100个历程,使用Ray数据平行在8个NVIDIA L4 GPU分发,耗时约60小时。 我们用图表IoU(第4.1节)来选择最佳检查站。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价计量

blocks.en: Intrinsic Graph Quality Metrics
blocks.zh: 内向图质量计量

blocks.en: We compare predicted graphs against rule-based teacher graphs by representing each graph as a set of (parent string, child string) edge tuples and computing set-based precision, recall, and IoU (Intersection over Union). Whole Graph IoU , our primary metric, pools feature hierarchy and functional relation edges into a single set. We also report IoU at finer granularities (feature edges only, nodes, words), IoU@ k k (percentage of documents with IoU ≥ k / 100 \geq k/100 ), and coverage —the fraction of document words participating in the graph, reported as total word coverage and separately for features and relations. A systematic bias affects string matching: the rule-based parser normalizes extracted text (e.g., lemmatization), while the neural parser is purely extractive, so semantically correct predictions may count as mismatches. Since no human-annotated corpus exists, intrinsic metrics measure teacher agreement; the extrinsic search evaluation serves as the primary quality signal.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了预测的图表与基于规则的老师图表,将每个图表代表成一组(父弦,子弦)边缘的扭矩和基于计算设定的精度,回忆,以及IoU(Intersection over Union). 整体图 IoU,我们的主要度量衡,集合 具有等级和功能关系边缘 成一个集。 我们还在更细的颗粒上报告IoU(仅指地缘、节点、单词)、IoU@ k (IoU = k / 100\ geq k/100的文件的百分比),以及覆盖范围——参与图表的文件单词的一小部分,作为总单词覆盖,并分别报告特征和关系。 系统性偏差会影响字符串匹配:基于规则的剖析器会使被提取的文本正常化(如:lemmatization),而神经剖析器则纯粹是取取出,因此成像正确的预测可能算作错配. 由于不存在附加说明的教程,因此内在的衡量标准衡量教师协议;外部搜索评价是初级质量信号。

blocks.en: Extrinsic Search Evaluation
blocks.zh: 外向搜索评价

blocks.en: To evaluate the impact of graph quality on downstream search, the neural parser is integrated into the Graph Transformer retrieval system of [ 5 ] , which is trained on examiner-cited prior art to rank candidate patents by relevance. On the evaluation set, this system with rule-based parser (Recall@3 = 0.416) substantially outperforms dense retrieval: PaECTER [ 11 ] achieves 0.280, Stella [ 20 ] 0.273, and GTE-ModernBERT [ 21 ] 0.200, despite using up to 4,096 tokens per chunk. The rule-based parser thus represents a strong baseline rather than a straw man.
blocks.zh: 为了评价图质对下游搜索的影响,神经剖析器被整合入[5]的"图变形器检索系统",该系统接受关于考生所引用的先行艺术的培训,根据相关性对候选专利进行分级. 在评价集上,这个基于规则的解析器(Recall@3=0.416)的系统在实质上超过了密集检索:PaECTER[11]实现0.280,Stella[20]0.273,以及GTE-ModernBERT[21]0.20,尽管每个块使用高达4,096个令牌. 因此,基于规则的解析器代表了强有力的基线,而不是稻草人。

blocks.en: We evaluate using examiner-cited references as relevance labels, considering both X citations (documents particularly relevant to novelty of the claimed invention) and Y citations (documents relevant when combined with other references, challenging inventive step). We report citation-averaged Recall@ k k : Recall@ ​ k = 1 | Q | ​ ∑ q ∈ Q | Retrieved k ​ ( q ) ∩ Citations ​ ( q ) | | Citations ​ ( q ) | \text{Recall@}k=\frac{1}{|Q|}\sum_{q\in Q}\frac{|\text{Retrieved}_{k}(q)\cap\text{Citations}(q)|}{|\text{Citations}(q)|} (4) where Q Q is the query set and Retrieved k ​ ( q ) \text{Retrieved}_{k}(q) the top- k k candidates. We use k = 3 k{=}3 as the primary metric. Results are reported on three subsets: all 90,082 queries, the 11,698 chemical patent queries (identified by CPC classification classes C01, C05, C07, C08, C09, C10, C11, and C13), and the remaining 78,384 non-chemical queries.
blocks.zh: 我们评价使用审查员引用的参考材料作为相关标签,同时考虑X引文(与所称发明的新颖性特别相关的文件)和Y引文(与其他参考材料结合相关的文件,具有挑战性的创新步骤)。 我们报告引用平均重回@kk: 回忆@ k = 1 = Q = Q = Q = Q = Q = Q = 引用 (q) = Q 引用 (q) =\ text =\ text { recall @}k=\frac{ 1}{|Q|}\sum_{q\ in Q}\frac{|\text { retrieved}_{k} (q)\ cap\text{t{ (q)\text{t{ (q)|}. (4)其中QQ是查询集,而Retrieved k (q)\text{Retrieved}_{k}(q)是上-克候选人. 我们使用 k = 3 k{=}3作为主要衡量标准. 报告的结果分为三个子集:所有90,082个查询,11,698个化学专利查询(由CPC分类类别C01,C05,C07,C08,C09,C10,C11,和C13确定),其余78,384个非化学查询.

blocks.en: We evaluate graph quality on the held-out test set of 5,000 documents described in Section 3.4 , processed at full length.
blocks.zh: 我们按照第3.4节所述5 000份文件的搁置测试评估图表质量。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.1 主要成果

blocks.en: Intrinsic Graph Quality
blocks.zh: 内向图质量

blocks.en: Table 2 compares the best neural parser against the rule-based teacher on the test set of 5,000 documents.
blocks.zh: 表2比较了5000个文档的测试集中最好的神经分解器和基于规则的老师.

blocks.en: Table 2: Intrinsic graph quality on the test set (5,000 documents). The rule-based teacher achieves IoU=1.0 by definition since it generates the training labels.
blocks.zh: 表2:测试集的内向图质量(5 000份文件)。 基于规则的老师从定义上实现了IoU=1.0,因为它生成了培训标签.

blocks.en: The neural parser achieves 0.653 IoU with the rule-based teacher, measuring distillation fidelity rather than absolute quality. Word coverage exceeds the teacher (0.861 vs 0.847), indicating richer graph structures; whether this translates to search improvement is answered below (training details in Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 神经分解器与有章可循的老师一起实现0.653 IoU,测量分解忠诚度而不是绝对质量. 文字覆盖超过老师(0.861 vs. 0.847),表示更加丰富的图表结构;这是否转化为搜索改进,下面回答(第5.2节中的培训细节.).

blocks.en: Search Recall
blocks.zh: 搜索召回

blocks.en: Table 3 presents extrinsic evaluation on the downstream search task using 90,082 queries, each paired with a known relevant reference retrieved from 168,809 documents. We evaluate two configurations: (1) Claims —only query graphs are re-parsed with the neural parser; (2) Descriptions —both query and corpus document graphs are re-parsed, using a 3-million-document neural-parsed subset (see Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 表3利用90 082个查询,对下游搜索任务进行了外部评价,每个查询都附有从168 809个文件中检索到的已知相关参考资料。 我们评价两种配置:(1) 索赔——只有查询图与神经剖析器重分;(2) 说明——查询和实体文件图均重分,使用300万个文件的神经剖析子集(见第5.3节)。

blocks.en: Table 3: Search recall (Recall@3). Claims : queries re-parsed, corpus rule-based. Descriptions : both re-parsed on a corpus subset. Significance via McNemar’s paired test (one-sided): ∗ p < 0.05 {}^{*}p<0.05 , p ∗ ⁣ ∗ < 0.01 {}^{**}p<0.01 .
blocks.zh: 表3:检索(召回) 索赔:查询重新解析,按事由规则处理。 说明 : 两者均重新分出在一个命案子集上。 通过McNemar的配对测试(单侧)具有意义: * p < 0.05 {}^{*}p < 0.05,p * * < 0.01 页:1

blocks.en: Both overall improvements are statistically significant under McNemar’s paired test over 90,082 queries ( p = 0.04 p=0.04 for claims; p < 0.001 p<0.001 for descriptions). Re-parsing both queries and corpus documents yields the larger gain (+1.1% vs +0.5%), confirming that consistent neural graphs on both sides of retrieval—rather than query-side improvements alone—are the key driver.
blocks.zh: McNemar的对接测试显示,在90 082次查询(索赔案的p = 0.04 p = 0.04;说明案的p < 0.001 p < 0.001)中,这两个总体改进在统计上都具有重大意义。 重新分析查询和实体文件可产生更大的收益(+1.1%对+0.5%),这证实检索的两侧的神经图一致,而不是单是查询方面的改进,是关键驱动力。

blocks.en: The chemical subset does not reach significance ( p = 0.42 p=0.42 claims, p = 0.14 p=0.14 descriptions), despite showing the largest qualitative improvements in graph structure (Figure 5 ). This suggests the chemical validation set may be too small to capture observed gains; domain-specific evaluation protocols remain future work.
blocks.zh: 化学子集没有达到意义(p=0.42 p=0.42索赔,p=0.14 p=0.14描述),尽管在图表结构(图5)中显示出最大的质量改进. 这表明,化学鉴定组可能太小,无法捕捉观察到的收益;针对特定领域的评价协议仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en: Graph Structure Analysis
blocks.zh: 图表结构分析

blocks.en: Table 4 compares structural properties of graphs generated by each parser.
blocks.zh: 表4比较了每个解析器生成的图表的结构属性.

blocks.en: Table 4: Graph structure comparison between rule-based and neural parsers.
blocks.zh: 表4:基于规则和神经分解器的图结构比较。

blocks.en: The neural parser produces slightly shallower graphs (depth 2.057 vs 2.157) while achieving higher coverage across all metrics, suggesting a more balanced representation. Figure 5 illustrates this on a chemical patent: the neural parser extracts 13 chemical constituents as individual features where the rule-based parser captures only 3 top-level features, directly benefiting downstream search for specific alloy compositions.
blocks.zh: 神经分解器产生略浅的图(深度为2.057相 2.157相克),同时实现所有度量衡的更高覆盖度,表明代表性更加平衡. 图5在一项化学专利中说明了这一点:神经分解器提取出13个化学成分作为单个特征,根据规则分解器只捕获出3个顶级特征,直接使下游搜索特定合金成分受益.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Rule-based vs. neural parser output for a chemical patent claim (WO2025012182A1). The rule-based parser extracts only 3 features, while the neural parser identifies 13 features and 5 relations capturing element compositions. This domain—chemical compositions with numerical ranges—is particularly challenging for hand-crafted rules.
blocks.zh: 图5:一项化学专利要求的基于规则与神经剖析器输出(WO2025012182A1)。 基于规则的解析器只提取出3个特征,而神经解析器则识别出13个特征和5个关系来捕捉元素组成. 这个领域——具有数值范围的化学成分——对手工制作的规则尤其具有挑战性。

blocks.en: 5.2 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 5.2 阅读研究

blocks.en: Training Configuration Ablation
blocks.zh: 培训配置

blocks.en: Table 5 summarizes the effect of key training decisions. We vary training set size, document length filtering, loss weights, and root penalization. All models are evaluated at the best checkpoint (maximum IoU over 100 epochs) on the same 5,000-document test set.
blocks.zh: 表5总结了关键培训决定的影响。 我们的训练设置大小、文件长度过滤、减重和根惩罚各不相同。 所有模型都在同一5000个文件测试集上的最佳检查站(最大IoU超过100个纪元)进行评估.

blocks.en: Table 5: Ablation of training configuration. All models use 100 training epochs; metrics reported at best checkpoint (max IoU). Coverage: fraction of document words assigned to graph features.
blocks.zh: 表5:培训配置情况。 所有模型都使用100个培训时代;在最佳检查站(最大IoU)报告衡量标准。 覆盖范围:指定给图表特性的文档单词的一小部分.

blocks.en: Scaling from 100K to 1M training examples yields the largest single improvement: IoU rises from 0.614 to 0.651, with coverage increasing from 0.797 to 0.846 as the model generalizes to a wider vocabulary of feature expressions.
blocks.zh: 从100K到1M的训练实例产生最大的单一改进:IoU从0.614上升到0.651,其覆盖面从0.797增加到了0.846,因为模型概括到更广泛的特征表达词汇。

blocks.en: Training exclusively on documents with ≤ \leq 600 words (combined with the 70% coverage filter from Section 3.4 ) improves recall from 0.772 to 0.780 while maintaining IoU, even though inference uses full-length documents. The rule-based teacher produces higher-quality labels on shorter patents, and the model learns structural patterns that generalize beyond the training length distribution.
blocks.zh: 专门使用 \\leq 600字(加上第3.4节的70%覆盖过滤器)进行的文件培训,在保留IoU的同时,将恢复到0.772至0.780,尽管推断使用全长文件。 基于规则的老师在更短的专利上生产出更高质量的标签,而模型学习了超出训练长度分布的通俗化的结构模式.

blocks.en: Down-weighting the None class is essential: asymmetric weights (feature 0.05, relation 0.10) outperform symmetric alternatives. Increasing the root loss weight to encourage deeper structures does not improve IoU (0.637 vs 0.653) and decreases precision; we use the default equal root weight.
blocks.zh: 将 " 无 " 类减重至关重要:不对称权重(尺寸为0.05,关系为0.10)超过对称性替代品。 增加根减重来鼓励更深的结构并不能改善IoU(0.637 vs 6.653)并降低精度;我们使用默认的等同根重.

blocks.en: Window Size and Document Length
blocks.zh: 窗口大小和文档长度

blocks.en: Analysis of the training data confirms that 98% of parent-child relationships occur within 2048 words, justifying local attention. To evaluate window size at inference time, we measure search recall using all claims combined as queries (concatenation of all independent claims per patent), since global attention on full corpus documents exceeds memory.
blocks.zh: 对培训数据的分析证实,98%的父母-子女关系发生在2048个字以内,因此有理由引起当地关注。 为了在推断时间评估窗口大小,我们用所有权利要求加在一起作为查询(每项专利的所有独立权利要求的处理)来衡量检索召回情况,因为全球对完整内容文件的关注超过了记忆。

blocks.en: Table 6: Effect of attention window size on search recall (Recall@3), measured using all-claims queries. In production, an adaptive strategy selects the largest window fitting NVIDIA L4 memory (24 GB): global for < < 5K words, 2048 for 5K–15K, 1024 for > > 15K.
blocks.zh: 表6 注意窗口大小对检索召回的影响(召回@3),用所有索赔查询法衡量。 在生产中,一个适应性策略选择了装有 NVIDIA L4 内存(24 GB)的最大窗口:全局为 < 5K字,2048为5K–15K,1024为 > 1万5千块

blocks.en: Larger windows consistently improve recall (Table 6 ), with global attention as the upper bound. The adaptive strategy maximizes recall within the GPU memory budget by assigning each document the largest feasible window.
blocks.zh: 较大的窗口不断改善召回(表6),全球关注是上限。 适应性战略在GPU内存预算范围内最大限度地召回,为每份文件指定了最大的可行窗口.

blocks.en: 5.3 Deployment Experience
blocks.zh: 5.3 部署经验

blocks.en: The search pipeline has two parsing stages: query parsing at search time and corpus indexing of full patent descriptions offline. The neural parser is deployed in production for query parsing, replacing the rule-based parser with no user-facing disruptions; an internal evaluation by domain experts with patent search background confirmed structural equivalence for most documents, with neural graphs capturing additional features in challenging domains such as chemical compositions (Figure 5 ). This corresponds to the Claims configuration (+0.5% recall). For corpus indexing, we have validated inference quality and cost on a 3-million-document subset (the Descriptions configuration, +1.1% recall); scaling to the full 150 million documents remains in progress.
blocks.zh: 搜索管道有两个解析阶段:在搜索时间进行查询解析;对专利说明全文进行离线索引。 神经元解析器被部署在制作中用于查询解析,用没有用户的解析器取代了基于规则的解析器;由具有专利搜索背景的域专家进行内部评价,确认大多数文档的结构等同,神经元图在化学成分等有挑战性的域中捕捉到额外的特征(图5). 这与索赔的配置(收回0.5%)相符。 就编制实体索引而言,我们已经核实了300万文件子集的推论质量和成本(说明配置,+1.1%召回);目前仍在逐步达到1.5亿份文件。

blocks.en: The biaffine model runs on fourth-generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors with native bfloat16 support, eliminating the need for GPUs in online serving. Throughput increases from 2 to 10 queries per second per CPU instance, and average latency drops from 2–3 seconds to under 1 second. Long queries that previously timed out after 60+ seconds (common for chemical patents with complex formulas) complete in under 5 seconds; inputs are truncated at 40,000 characters as a safety bound.
blocks.zh: biaffine模型运行在第四代英特尔Xeon可扩展处理器上并有本土bfloat16支持,从而消除了在线服务中对GPU的需求. 每个CPU实例的通量从每秒2个查询增加到了每秒10个查询,而平均延迟从2至3秒降至1秒以下。 此前在60+秒后超时的长询问(常见于化学专利有复杂公式)在5秒以内完成;输入以4万个字符为安全约束.

blocks.en: We parsed 3 million documents as a single distributed Ray Data job on 10 NVIDIA L4 spot GPU instances, with CPUs on the same nodes handling pre- and post-processing. The job completed in two days without out-of-memory errors. GPU utilization exceeded 70%, though variable-size tree outputs create packing challenges in Ray Data workers that limit further utilization. At current utilization, batch parsing cost is estimated at 3 × \times lower than the rule-based system; improving GPU utilization to 90%+ would bring this to 5 × \times . Scaling beyond 3 million documents will require a full orchestration framework with improved observability and error recovery.
blocks.zh: 我们在10个NVIDIA L4斑点GPU实例上解析出300万个文档作为单发的Ray Data工作,其中CPU在同一节点上处理前处理后处理. 工作在两天内完成,没有出现出错. GPU利用率超过70%,尽管可变大小的树产出给Ray Data工人带来包装挑战,限制了进一步利用. 在目前的利用率下,批量分析费用估计比基于规则的系统低出3×分;将GPU利用率提高到90×分将达5×分。 超过300万份文件的扩增需要有一个完整的协调框架,改进可观察性和错误回收。

blocks.en: The neural parser largely reproduces the rule-based system’s strengths and weaknesses: domains where rules worked well remain strong, and challenging cases (e.g., Markush structures) remain difficult. One unexpected issue arose from training on short documents: the model preserved patent jargon such as “according to claim 1” that the rule-based parser had filtered out, especially in longer inputs combining claims and descriptions. Rather than retraining on longer sequences—which risked degrading metrics (Section 5.2 )—we applied a simple regex post-filter.
blocks.zh: 神经解析器在很大程度上复制了基于规则的系统的长处和短处:规则运行良好的领域依然强大,挑战性案例(如马库什结构)依然困难. 一个出人意料的问题来自对短文件的培训:模型保留了专利术语,例如“根据索赔1”,基于规则的剖析器已经过滤出,特别是在将索赔和描述结合起来的较长的投入中。 与其在较长的序列上进行再培训——这有降低衡量标准的风险(第5.2节),不如使用简单的过滤器。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We showed that biaffine structured prediction, made tractable for long documents via local attention with shared weights, can replace brittle rule-based patent graph extraction. Knowledge distillation from 1 million rule-parsed examples produces a model that surpasses its teacher on downstream citation recall across both query-only and full-pipeline configurations, while reducing inference cost. Future work includes expert-annotated data to move beyond the teacher ceiling, joint training with the search model, and multilingual extension.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,通过共同的权重,通过本地注意力为长文件提供方便的双叶林结构预测可以取代基于Brittle规则的专利图提取。 知识从100万个规则分解的例子中分解出来,产生了一个模型,在下游的引用召回方面超越了它的老师,既包括只查询的,也包括全管的配置,同时降低了推论成本. 今后的工作包括提供专家说明的数据,以超越教师上限,与搜索模式联合培训,以及多语种扩展。
